data.title: Orange juice
data.subtitle: Risks of Orange Juice
data.content: One cup of orange juice contains over 100 calories, which can quickly add up if you're sipping orange juice throughout the day. In addition, unlike whole oranges, orange juice has little to no fiber. This means it's less likely to keep you feeling full for an extended period

data.title: Apple Juice
data.subtitle: Raw apple juice benefits
data.content: When it comes to choosing apples, there are plenty of options to choose from. Which you go for will depend on the taste, acidity, sweetness, color, etc., that you  prefer (and what is available to you).

data.title: Banana juice
